rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unusual expression is an Arabic interrogative of astonishment that functions as an appeal to tell or inform.
rows.anchor: أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ Bu tâbir lisân-ı Arabda nazîri bulunmayan bir kelime-i istifham ve taaccübdür

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although a literal parse seems to ask whether one saw oneself, grammarians treat the phrase as an irregular construction without ordinary subject and object roles.
rows.anchor: nahivde bu suretle fâil ve mef‘ul olmayıp alâ gayr-i kıyas bir terkib olduğu beyan olunuyor

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The forms with attached pronouns function emphatically and interpretively, conveying an astonished demand to report.
rows.anchor: أَرَأَيْتَكَ “sen sen gördün mü?” أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ “sen siz gördünüz mü?” makamında bir tekid ve tefsir mânasında bulunduğu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verb is used through four derivations: visual seeing, opinion or inward perception, cognitive seeing with two objects, and cognitive seeing meaning to inform.
rows.anchor: üzere dört iştikak ile isti‘mâl edilir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the first three derivations, the second hamza may be pronounced fully or eased between sounds, but may not be dropped.
rows.anchor: Evvelki üçünde asl-ı kelimeden olan ikinci hemze ya tahkik veya beyne beyne teshil ile okunur, hazfi câiz olmaz

rows.speaker: Nâfi‘, Ebû Ca‘fer, Kisâî, Verş, cumhur
rows.claim: In the informing sense, the majority read with full hamza; Nafi and Abu Ja'far ease it, Kisai omits it, and Warsh substitutes a long alif, a form also found in Arabic despite the morphology rule.
rows.anchor: cumhur kıraatlerinde tahkik ile Nâfi‘ve Ebû Ca‘fer’de teshil ile, Kisâî’de iskāt ile ve Verş’te ibdal ile okunmuştur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the informing usage, the verb's ta ending may vary according to the addressee, as in ordinary conjugation.
rows.anchor: muhâtabın ihtilâfına göre أَرَأَيْتَ أَرَأَيـْتُمْ أَرَأَيْتِ gibi “tâ”nın ke’l-evvel ihtilâfı câiz olduğu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This verb uniquely permits the masculine singular ta to remain open while a separately inflected attached kaf signals the addressee.
rows.anchor: ihtilâf-ı muhâtabı iş‘âr için âhirine أَرَأَيـْتَكَ أَرَأَيـْتَكُمْ gibi muhtelif surette kâf-ı muttasıla ilhâkı da câiz olur ki bu hâl bu fiile mahsustur

rows.speaker: Basriyyûn
rows.claim: The Basran explanation treats kum in ara'aytum as a marker of the varying subject, not as an object.
rows.anchor: Yani كُمْ zamîri mef‘ul değil, fâ‘ilin ihtilâfına delâlet eden bir harftir. Basriyyûnun îzâhı budur

rows.speaker: Kisâî
rows.claim: Kisai instead considers the attached pronoun to occupy the position of the first object.
rows.anchor: Fakat Kisâî bunun mef‘ûl-i evvel makamında olduğuna kāil olmuştur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two forms both mean inform me, but ara'aytaka asks about awareness of one's own inward experience, whereas ara'aytum asks about awareness in general.
rows.anchor: kalbin vâki‘de kendine ve kendi enfüsiyyâtına

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author finds Kisai's analysis especially noteworthy because it fits grammatical analogy and explains the subtle semantic contrast.
rows.anchor: Kisâî mezhebi hem kıyâs-ı nahve muvâfık, hem de bu ince farkı ibraz etmiş olmak hasebiyle bizce daha ziyade şâyân-ı dikkattir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is told to make the idolaters examine their consciences and report whether they would call on anyone besides God when punishment or the Hour arrives.
rows.anchor: Yani vicdanlarınızın derinliklerine inerek kendinizi iyice yoklayınız, tartınız bakayım

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The threatened punishment recalls worldly destruction of earlier communities, while the Hour is the certain Day of Resurrection.
rows.anchor: Eğer size Allah’ın -dünyada münkariz olan ümmetlere gelen- azâbı gelirse

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question pictures the soul in deadly crisis: will it fall into total despair or keep hoping for rescue, and to whom will it then plead?
rows.anchor: Bütün ümidleriniz silinir, ölmüş gibi ye’s-i küllîye mi düşersiniz? Yoksa henüz canınız çıkmadıkça yine bir ümîd-i halâs besler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the idolaters truly believe in other gods, they should say whether they would still hope in and pray to them in such a crisis.
rows.anchor: Eğer siz sâdık iseniz, hakikatte Allah’tan başka ilâhlar vardır iddiasında yalancı değil iseniz söyleyiniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In that crisis they call only on God and place all their hope in Him.
rows.anchor: ancak Allah’a dua eder, her ne umarsanız O’ndan umar ve yalnız O’na niyaz edersiniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God removes the distress to which they prayed if He wills.
rows.anchor: O da dilerse dua ettiğiniz azâbı, sıkıntıyı açar, başınızdan def‘eder

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They forget their former partners during the crisis because reason and innate conscience know that only God can remove adversity; this is clear while reason and conscience remain alive.
rows.anchor: Çünkü keşf-i durra kādir merci‘-i yegâne ancak Allah olduğu fıtrat-ı ukūlde ve künh-i vicdanda merkuzdur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent messengers to many earlier communities; when they disbelieved, He pressed them with severe poverty and livelihood hardship, as well as illness and calamity.
rows.anchor: Biz de onları be’sâ’ yani şiddetli fakr, maişet darlığı ve darrâ, yani emrâz ve âfât ile sıktık

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The purpose was that people might humble themselves, recognize their abasement, repent, and seek forgiveness, though their response remained only possible or likely.
rows.anchor: ki tazarru‘etsinler, zilletlerini anlayıp isyanlarına tevbekâr olsunlar, gufrânımıza dehâlet eylesinler; yani bu hâl içinde tevbe ve tazarru‘etmeleri mümkin ve muhtemil idi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They failed to humble themselves when the pressure came; their hearts hardened, they lost receptivity, and became accustomed to poverty and hardship.
rows.anchor: velâkin etmediler, gittikçe kalbleri katılaştı. Kābiliyyet-i intibâhiyelerini zâyi‘ettiler, fakr u zarûrete alıştılar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan made their deeds seem good, so they regarded evil as good and sin as virtue until repentance became unlikely and conscience and reason were frozen.
rows.anchor: Yaptıklarını fena diye değil, iyi yapıyoruz diye yapmaya, şerri hayr, günahı sevap telakkī etmeye başladılar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Need and poverty belong to the creature's original condition; relief from them is an effect of divine mercy.
rows.anchor: fakr u ihtiyaç mahlûkun ‘adem-i aslîsi muktezâsı ve lâzım-ı mahiyetidir. Onu def‘ü izâle eden de rahmet-i ilâhiyedir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When divine mercy diminishes and hardship comes, it is an active reminder that reveals human limits and dependence, awakening righteousness and servitude; understood rightly, it is a blessing.
rows.anchor: fakr u zarûret ve tazyik ile âsî ve serkeş insanlara hadlerini ve kendi kendilerine bırakıldığı zaman muktezâ-yı mâhiyetlerini ihsas ve irâe ederek hiss-i salâh ve ubûdiyeti uyandıracak bir âyet-i fi‘liye

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those facing divine pressure should first treat it as a blessing, quickly break their rebellion, recognize servile helplessness, repent, and return to God and righteousness.
rows.anchor: böyle bir tazyîk-i ilâhîye mâruz olanlar onu evvelemirde nimet bilmeli ve serî‘bir surette intibah hâsıl ederek nefsin tuğyânını kırmalı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The quicker the awakening, the greater its benefit in this world and the next; those who repent will at least benefit in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: Bu intibah ne kadar serî‘olursa dünya ve âhiret fâidesi de o kadar mühim olur. Bunu idrak edip tevbekâr olanlar dünyada olmazsa her hâlde ukbâda istifade ederler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning's first severe effect weakens over time, while the possibility of awakening declines and becomes more difficult.
rows.anchor: En şedîd olan ilk tesir lahzaları geçtikçe ihtârın kuvveti tenâkus eder, daha ziyade teşdîdine lüzum hâsıl olur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once the limited period ends, pressure loses its formative effect, becomes habit, hardens hearts, and rebellion then grows unchecked.
rows.anchor: nihâyet o müddet-i mahdûde biter, tazyîkin bütün kuvve-i ihtâriyesi de tükenir, bir i‘tiyâd u tab‘hâline gelir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine discipline should not remain prolonged; pressure is used to reform or stop corruption, but where hardship breeds evil, easing is more likely to reform than intensifying it.
rows.anchor: Bunun için terbiyevî bir hikmet ve maksadla tatbik olunacak tazyik ve teşdid uzun ve devamlı olmamak lâzım gelir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author invokes the maxim that what becomes constricted expands, applying it to easing pressure on hardened hearts.
rows.anchor: إذَا اَل َّشيْءُ ضَاقَ اِت َّسَعَ’dır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ease and expansion may soften pressured hearts, leading either to reform or to their breaking and end; in both cases evil is checked.
rows.anchor: Tazyik ile katılmış olan kalbleri yumuşatırsa teysir ve tevsî‘yumuşatabilir. Ve artık bu tevsî‘ve ittisâ‘onlara ya kesb-i salâh ettirir veya patlatır bitirir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The forgotten reminders include the gradual warnings conveyed by messengers and the poverty and calamity meant to teach repentance and supplication.
rows.anchor: Evvela, bir teysîr-i tedrîcî ifade eden ihtârât-ı rusülü, sâniyen tevbe ve tazarru‘telkin eden be’sâ’ ve darrâ’ muhtıralarını düşünmek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After hardship, God opened every kind of door and gave such material and spiritual ease that obstacles fell away and blessings, health, victories, success, and pleasures were abundant.
rows.anchor: ürriyet ve refah verdik ki maddî mânevî bütün mâni‘aları kaldırdık

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This unrestricted prosperity was a test and increased their gradual entrapment (istidrāj).
rows.anchor: Öyle serbest bir imtihana kondular ve öyle istidracları arttı ki

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They took prosperity as proof that their path was right and their success deserved, felt free of responsibility, and indulged as though God and the afterlife did not exist.
rows.anchor: Tuttukları yolun iyi olduğuna ve bütün bunlar kendi istihkakları bulunduğuna ve her mes’ûliyetten âzâde olduklarına hükmettiler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the height of their joy, God seized them suddenly; they were left frozen in complete despair and deprivation of hope.
rows.anchor: Tam böyle ferahlandıkları, gel keyfim gel dedikleri sırada

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oppressive, ungrateful people were entirely destroyed, leaving no one behind and bringing their injustice to an end.
rows.anchor: Arkalarından hiç kimse bırakılmadı, hepsi ihlâk edildi ve bu suretle zulümlerine nihâyet verildi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After every warning, manifestation of mercy, and trial, punishing even such wrongdoers and clearing the earth of oppression and mischief is a great reason for God's servants to give thanks.
rows.anchor: böyle zâlimleri bile her türlü ihtârâtı yaptıktan ve rubûbiyyet-i ilâhiyenin her nevi âsâr-ı rahmetini gösterip her imtihandan geçirdikten sonra ta‘zîb ve ihlâk etmek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As with every blessing, praise and gratitude for this too belong to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
rows.anchor: Her nimet gibi bunun da hamd ü şükrânı, Rabbü’l-âlemîn olan Allah’adır, O’nun hakkıdır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse asks whether people would bypass the God who possesses every divine attribute and call on powerless idols, creatures, and artifacts that cannot benefit or harm even themselves.
rows.anchor: Allah’tan geçerek bize, kendi kendilerine ne menfaat ve ne zarar bile veremeyecek olan şeylere, cansız putlara, âciz mahluklara, masnû‘lara mı yalvaracağız

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning back on one's heels means reverting after God has shown the right path.
rows.anchor: Allah bize hidâyet ettikten, doğru yolu gösterdikten sonra gerimize mi döneceğiz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The simile depicts a bewildered person on earth whom devils draw toward passion and error while companions call him toward guidance and urge him to come.
rows.anchor: yeryüzünde hayran ve sersem kalarak şeytanların hevâ ve hevese çekip şaşırdığı şaşkın gibi mi olacağız

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report identifies the occasion as Abdurrahman, son of Abu Bakr, before his conversion: while the Prophet, Abu Bakr, and other Companions invited him to Islam, he called his father to idolatry.
rows.anchor: sebeb-i nüzûlü Hazret-i Ebû Bekir’in oğlu Abdurrahman’ın imanından evvelki hâli olduğu hakkında bir rivayet vardır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only God's guidance counts as guidance.
rows.anchor: rehber ancak Allah rehberidir, ancak Allah hidâyetidir ki hidâyettir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command is to submit and obey specifically to the Lord of the worlds.
rows.anchor: bize bilhassa Rabbü’lâlemîn’e islâm ve inkıyad edelim

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People are commanded to establish prayer and fear God, to whom they will all be gathered.
rows.anchor: ve bize bilhassa Rabbü’lâlemîn’e islâm ve inkıyad edelim

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God created the heavens and earth in truth: they are real creations, testify to truth, and cannot have falsehood, play, or purposelessness as their origin or end; all return to God and truth.
rows.anchor: semâvât ve arzın hilkati eğlence ve oyuncak, bâtıl ve abes ve hikmetsiz olamaz. Hepsi Hak’ta toplanacak ve Hak teâlâ’ya haşr olunacaktır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When God says Be, it happens; His word is true and what He says will occur.
rows.anchor: O’nun hak kelâmıdır, “ol” dediği gün, olacaktır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the day the trumpet is blown, all rule and sovereignty belong exclusively to God.
rows.anchor: kıyamet borusu çalındığı gün mülk, hükm ü saltanat tamamen ve müstakillen O’nun

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows the unseen and the witnessed, including what will emerge or collapse when the trumpet is blown and what is presently observable.
rows.anchor: sûr üfürüldüğü gün meydana çıkacak olan gaybı ve yıkılacak olan bu günkü meşhûdâtı bilen O’dur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone is the Wise and the All-Aware.
rows.anchor: Ve Hakîm O, Habîr O’dur
